### Scaling centring and subsetting

Data are subsetted for different analyses and scaling is conducted within each subset
```{r subset data}
# create a list to hold all the subsetted data
study_data <- list()

# store the raw data
study_data$raw <- study_list

# prepare the data for analysis - recalculate some variables
study_data$raw <- lapply(study_data$raw, function(data){
  
  # dummy recodes for simple slopes
  data$inf_received_dummy <- dplyr::recode(data$information_received_ec, `-1` = 0, `1` = 1) 
  data$inf_not_received_dummy <- dplyr::recode(data$information_received_ec, `1` = 0, `-1` = 1) 
  
  # make the n_pumps adjust variable by subtracting n_pumps from next_trial_n_pumps
  data$n_pumps_adjust <- data$next_trial_n_pumps - data$n_pumps
  
  # make a variable that tracks whether information was sought on the next trial
  data$next_trial_info_sought <- NA
  data$next_trial_info_sought[data$trial %in% 0:58] <- data$information_sought[data$trial %in% 1:59]
  
  # Because some participants pressed enter in the age field, their age included "\n" and so came out as NA in the as.numeric function. 
  # This has been corrected here:
  if(!is.numeric(data$age)){ 
    data$age <- as.numeric(unlist(lapply(strsplit(data$age, "\\n"), function(x)x[[1]])))
  }
  
  # return all the data
  data
})

# list non-categorical predictors (to be centered within subject and standardised)
predictors <- c("n_pumps", # number of pumps made
                "limit", # balloon's limit
                "diff_pumps_limit", # missed opportunity
                "pump_value", # number of points each pump is worth
                "trial", # the trial number
                "outcome_rating", # the first rating after seeing the outcome
                "emotion_change_rating", # the second rating after seeing or not seeing the information
                "next_trial_n_pumps", # number of pumps made on the next trial
                "n_pumps_adjust", # adjustment of pumps on the next trial
                "next_trial_points" # number of points banked on the next trial
                )


ID_scale <- function(data, predictors, standardize = T){
  # scale 
    for(predictor in predictors){
      if(standardize){
          data[,paste(predictor, "Z", sep="_")] <- scale(data[, predictor], center = F)
      }
      data[,paste(predictor, "ID_mean_Z", sep="_")] <-  tapply(data[,paste(predictor, "Z", sep="_")], data$subject, mean, na.rm=T)[as.character(data$subject)]
      data[,paste(predictor, "IDS", sep="_")] <- as.numeric(data[,paste(predictor, "Z", sep="_")]) -as.numeric(data[,paste(predictor, "ID_mean_Z", sep="_")])
      data[,paste(predictor, "ID_mean", sep="_")] <-  tapply(data[,predictor], data$subject, mean, na.rm=T)[as.character(data$subject)]
      data[,paste(predictor, "IDC", sep="_")] <- as.numeric(data[,predictor]) -as.numeric(data[,paste(predictor, "ID_mean", sep="_")])
    }
  
  # interaction terms for SEM
  data$`value_IS` <- data$pump_value_IDS*data$information_received_ec
  data$`diff_IS` <- data$diff_pumps_limit_IDS*data$information_received_ec
  
  data
}

# group mean scale the predictors for each subset (but don't standardize again)
study_data$all <- lapply(study_data$raw, function(data){
    ID_scale(data, predictors)
})

# group mean scale the predictors for each subset (but don't standardize again)
# Try harder trials are excluded from effort experiments.
study_data$bank <- lapply(study_data$all, function(data){
    ID_scale(data[data$outcome=="bank" & data$information_outcome!='try harder',], predictors, standardize = F)
})


study_data$bust <- lapply(study_data$all, function(data){
    ID_scale(data[data$outcome=="bust" & data$information_outcome!='try harder',], predictors, standardize = F)
})


# data for exploratory analysis looking at motivation to seek information
study_data$fb_bank_bank <- lapply(study_data$all, function(data){
    df <- ID_scale(data[data$outcome=="bank" & data$next_trial_bank==1 & data$information_outcome=='yes',], predictors, standardize = F)
})


# save the study data
save(study_data, file = "study_data.RData")

```

## Task descriptives
```{r task descriptives}
# descriptives of task performance by participant
ppt_summary <- lapply(study_data$raw, function(data){
  ddply(.data = data, .variables = .(subject), .fun = summarise, 
        mean_n_pumps = mean(n_pumps),
        prop_bank = sum(outcome=="bank")/60,
        prop_bust = sum(outcome=="bust")/60,
        prop_inf = sum(information_sought)/60,
        prop_inf_bank = sum(information_sought & outcome=="bank")/sum(outcome=="bank"),
        prop_inf_bust = sum(information_sought & outcome=="bust")/sum(outcome=="bust")
  )
})

# summarise the descriptives of task behaviour within each experiment
task_descriptives <-  as.data.frame(t(as.data.frame(lapply(ppt_summary, function(data){
  c(study=NA,
    mean_n_pumps = mean(data$mean_n_pumps),
    se_n_pumps = sd(data$mean_n_pumps)/sqrt(30),
    mean_prop_bank = mean(data$prop_bank),
    se_prop_bank = sd(data$prop_bank)/sqrt(30),
    mean_prop_bust = mean(data$prop_bust),
    se_prop_bust = sd(data$prop_bust)/sqrt(30),
    mean_prop_inf_bank = mean(data$prop_inf_bank),
    se_prop_inf_bank = sd(data$prop_inf_bank)/sqrt(30),
    CI_lower_prop_inf_bank = t.test(data$prop_inf_bank)$conf.int[1],
    CI_upper_prop_inf_bank = t.test(data$prop_inf_bank)$conf.int[2],
    mean_prop_inf_bust = mean(data$prop_inf_bust),
    se_prop_inf_bust = sd(data$prop_inf_bust)/sqrt(30)
    )
}))), row.names = F)

# add the study labels
task_descriptives$study <- studies

# meta analyses of descriptive statistics are reported
meta_pumps <- rma.uni(yi = task_descriptives$mean_n_pumps, sei = task_descriptives$se_n_pumps, method = "REML")
meta_bank <- rma.uni(yi = task_descriptives$mean_prop_bank, sei = task_descriptives$se_prop_bank, method = "REML")
meta_inf_bank <- rma.uni(yi = task_descriptives$mean_prop_inf_bank, sei = task_descriptives$se_prop_inf_bank, method = "REML")
meta_inf_bust <- rma.uni(yi = task_descriptives$mean_prop_inf_bust, sei = task_descriptives$se_prop_inf_bust, method = "REML")

# bind the summart into a dataframe for a nice table
df <- rbind(task_descriptives[,c("mean_n_pumps", "se_n_pumps", "mean_prop_bank", "se_prop_bank", "mean_prop_inf_bank", "se_prop_inf_bank")],c(meta_pumps$b, meta_pumps$se, meta_bank$b, meta_bank$se, meta_inf_bank$b, meta_inf_bank$se), c(meta_pumps$I2, NA, meta_bank$I2, NA, meta_inf_bank$I2, NA))
df$se_n_pumps[1:7] <- paste0(" (", round(df$se_n_pumps[1:7],2), ")")
df$se_prop_bank[1:7] <- paste0(" (", round(df$se_prop_bank[1:7],2), ")")
df$se_prop_inf_bank[1:7] <- paste0(" (", round(df$se_prop_inf_bank[1:7],2), ")")
rownames(df) <-  c(studies, "Metaanalysis b", "Heterogeneity (I^2)")
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
kable(df, digits = 2, align=rep(c('r','l'), 3),format = "html", col.names = c("Mean pumps", "(SE)", "Mean proportion\nbank outcome", "(SE)", "Mean proportion\ninformation seeking\n(bank trials)","(SE)"))%>%
    kableExtra::group_rows(start_row = 1, end_row = length(studies), label_row_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid;") %>%
    kableExtra::group_rows(start_row = length(studies)+1, end_row = length(studies)+2, label_row_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid;")
```

## Emotional experience
```{r emotional experience}
# main effects of information seeking, pump value, and size of the missed opportunity on emotion change rating
emo_bank_1 <- lapply(study_data$bank, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~information_received_ec+pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC+
          (1+information_received_ec+pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})

# add interactions with information seeking - there are singular fit warnings for some of these models. These are resolved by removing the random effect of pump value without dramatically changing the results.
emo_bank_2 <- lapply(study_data$bank, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~information_received_ec*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)+
          (1+information_received_ec*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})

# run the meta analysis and print the data frame
meta_emo_bank_1 <- meta_func(emo_bank_1, studies)
meta_emo_bank_2 <- meta_func(emo_bank_2, studies)
kable(meta_emo_bank_1$df, digits = 3)
kable(meta_emo_bank_2$df, digits = 3)


# simple slopes (information received is dummy coded in both directions and main effects give simple slopes)
emo_bank_inf <- lapply(study_data$bank, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~inf_not_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)+
          (1+inf_not_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})

emo_bank_no_inf <- lapply(study_data$bank, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~inf_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)+
          (1+inf_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})


# run the meta analysis and print the data frame
meta_emo_inf_bank <- meta_func(emo_bank_inf, studies)
meta_emo_no_inf_bank <- meta_func(emo_bank_no_inf, studies)

kable(meta_emo_inf_bank$df, digits = 3)
kable(meta_emo_no_inf_bank$df, digits = 3)

# combine and summarise for plots
bank_data_all <- rbindlist(study_data$bank, fill = T, use.names = T, idcol = "experiment")
bank_data_all$`Information seeking` <- factor(bank_data_all$information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels = c("No information", "Information"))

summary_dat_bank = ddply(bank_data_all, .(subject, experiment, information_received_ec), summarize, emotion_change_rating = mean(emotion_change_rating))
summary_dat_bank$`Information seeking` <- factor(summary_dat_bank$information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels = c("No information", "Information"))

# plots
fig_2_a <- rain_plot(summary_dat_bank)
fig_2_b <- ggplot(bank_data_all, aes(x=diff_pumps_limit, y=emotion_change_rating_IDC, col=factor(information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("No information", "Information")), group=interaction(experiment, factor(information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("No information", "Information")))))+stat_smooth(geom="line", alpha=0.5,method="lm", se=F)+theme_classic()+labs(x="Missed opportunity", y="Emotion change rating",title="b")+stat_smooth(mapping=aes(x=diff_pumps_limit, y=emotion_change_rating_IDC, col=factor(information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("No information", "Information"))), method ="lm", inherit.aes = F)+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-200,200))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-12,12))+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name="")+theme(legend.position = c(0.85,0.85))
wrap_plots(fig_2_a, fig_2_b, widths = c(0.55,0.45))
```

## Downstream effects (Structural equation models) {.tabset}
### Model spec
```{r model specs}
   unsaturated_model <- '

      # mediation
      emotion_change_rating_Z ~ a*information_received_ec + x1*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x2*diff_IS + x3*pump_value_IDS + x4*value_IS
      n_pumps_adjust_Z ~ b*emotion_change_rating_Z + x5*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x6*diff_IS + x7*pump_value_IDS + x8*value_IS
    
      next_trial_bank ~ c*n_pumps_adjust_Z + x9*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x10*diff_IS + x11*pump_value_IDS + x12*value_IS
      next_trial_points_Z ~ d*n_pumps_adjust_Z + x15*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x16*diff_IS + x17*pump_value_IDS + x18*value_IS 
      
      
      # covariance
      next_trial_points_Z ~~ z1*next_trial_bank


      # information seeking via regret to outcome effects
      IS_outcome := a*b*c
      IS_points := a*b*d

  '

   saturated_model <- '

      # mediation
      emotion_change_rating_Z ~ a*information_received_ec + x1*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x2*diff_IS + x3*pump_value_IDS + x4*value_IS
      n_pumps_adjust_Z ~ b*emotion_change_rating_Z + x5*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x6*diff_IS + x7*pump_value_IDS + x8*value_IS + e*information_received_ec
    
      next_trial_bank ~ c*n_pumps_adjust_Z + x9*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x10*diff_IS + x11*pump_value_IDS + x12*value_IS + x13*emotion_change_rating_Z + x14*information_received_ec
      next_trial_points_Z ~ d*n_pumps_adjust_Z + x15*diff_pumps_limit_IDS + x16*diff_IS + x17*pump_value_IDS + x18*value_IS + x19*emotion_change_rating_Z + x20*information_received_ec
      
      
      # covariance
      next_trial_points_Z ~~ z1*next_trial_bank


      # information seeking via regret to outcome effects
      IS_outcome := a*b*c
      IS_points := a*b*d

  '

```


### Run the models {.tabset}
```{r model spec}

bank_unsaturated_mediation <- lapply(study_data$bank, function(data){
  fit <- sem(unsaturated_model, data = data, cluster = "subject", 
             ordered = c("next_trial_bank", "information_received_ec")
  )
  fit.survey <- lavaan.survey(fit, svydesign(ids = ~subject, prob=~1, data = data))
  list(fit=fit.survey, pe=parameterEstimates(fit.survey,  standardized = F))
})

bank_saturated_mediation <- lapply(study_data$bank, function(data){
  fit <- sem(saturated_model, data = data, cluster = "subject", 
             ordered = c("next_trial_bank", "information_received_ec")
  )
  fit.survey <- lavaan.survey(fit, svydesign(ids = ~subject, prob=~1, data = data))
  list(fit=fit.survey, pe=parameterEstimates(fit.survey, standardized = F))
})

bust_unsaturated_mediation <- lapply(study_data$bust, function(data){
  fit <- sem(unsaturated_model, data = data, cluster = "subject", 
             ordered = c("next_trial_bank", "information_received_ec")
  )
  fit.survey <- lavaan.survey(fit, svydesign(ids = ~subject, prob=~1, data = data))
  list(fit=fit.survey, pe=parameterEstimates(fit.survey,  standardized = F))
})

bust_saturated_mediation <- lapply(study_data$bust, function(data){
  fit <- sem(saturated_model, data = data, cluster = "subject", 
             ordered = c("next_trial_bank", "information_received_ec")
  )
  fit.survey <- lavaan.survey(fit, svydesign(ids = ~subject, prob=~1, data = data))
  list(fit=fit.survey, pe=parameterEstimates(fit.survey, standardized = F))
})

mediations <- list(`Bank unsaturated mediation`=bank_unsaturated_mediation, 
     `Bank saturated mediation`=bank_saturated_mediation, 
     `Bust unsaturated mediation`=bust_unsaturated_mediation, 
     `Bust saturated mediation`=bust_saturated_mediation)

save(mediations, file="mediations.RData")
```

### Model results  {.tabset}
```{r modelfits, results="asis", echo=F}
metas <- lapply(names(mediations), function(name){
  cat(paste("\n\n####", name, "{.tabset}   \n"))
  
  mediation <- mediations[[name]]
  
  cat("\n\n##### Meta-analysis  \n")
  meta_med <- meta_func_sem(mediation, names(mediation))
  print(scroll_box(kable_styling(kable(meta_med$df[order(meta_med$df$label),-c(1:3)], digits = 3, format = "html", sep.col=' '))),width="100%")
  
  lapply(names(mediation), function(exp){ 
    model <- mediation[[exp]]
    
    cat(paste("\n\n#####", exp, "   \n"))
    print(sem_paths(model$fit, standardized = TRUE, ci = "standardized"))
    print(kable_styling(kable(t(as.data.frame(fitmeasures(model$fit)[c("tli","rmsea","rmsea.ci.upper","rmsea.ci.lower","cfi")])),"html", row.names=F, digits=3, caption="Model fit indices", padding=0.1)))
  })

  meta_med
})

names(metas) <- names(mediations)

# output data for path diagram (used as variables in an Illustrator file to create the figure)
dat_for_paths <- rbindlist(lapply(metas, function(meta){
    x <- paste0(sprintf("%.3f",round(meta$df[meta$df$label %in% c("a", "b", "c", "d"),"est"],3)),meta$df[meta$df$label %in% c("a", "b", "c", "d"),"psig"])
    names(x) <- c("a", "b", "c", "d")
    as.data.frame(t(x))
    }), idcol = "name")


# write.csv(dat_for_paths, "dat_for_paths.csv")

url <- paste0('https://osf.io/aeu3m//?action=download')
filename <- 'sem_path_labels.csv'
GET(url, write_disk(filename, overwrite = TRUE))
sat_labs <- read.csv(filename, header=TRUE, na.strings="NA")


lapply(names(metas), function(meta){
  df <- merge(metas[[meta]]$df, sat_labs, all = F)
  df$`95% CI` <- paste0("[", format(round(df$ci.lower,3), nsmall=2), ", ", format(round(df$ci.upper,3), nsmall=2), "]")
  df <- df[order(df$order),c("pretty_label", "est", "se", "95% CI", "z", "pvalue", "I2")]
  df[,c("est", "se")] <- format(round(df[,c("est", "se")], 3), nsmall=3)
  df$z <- format(round(df$z, 2), nsmall=2)
  df$pvalue <- ifelse(df$pvalue<0.001, "< .001", substr(as.character(round(df$pvalue, 3)), 2, 5))
  df$I2 <- paste0(round(df$I2,0), "%")
  write.csv(df, file = paste0(meta, ".csv"), row.names = F, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
})
```

## Non-instrumentality of information
```{r non-instrumentality of information}
# pool data for plot of non-linear relationship between adjustment and obtained points
bank_data_all <- rbindlist(study_data$bank, fill = T, use.names = T, idcol = "experiment")

fig_4_a <- ggplot(bank_data_all, aes(x=n_pumps_adjust, y=next_trial_points))+
 stat_smooth(col="black")+theme_classic()+labs(x="Behavior  adjustment", y="Points banked on next trial", title="a")


# simulation function
simu <- function(runs = 10000, beta_lims = c(0,1), seed=101){
  set.seed(seed)
  dat.sum <- matrix(ncol = 4, nrow = runs)
  colnames(dat.sum) <- c("subject", "start.pumps", "sd.pumps", "beta")
  
  dat.sum[,"subject"] <- 1:runs
  dat.sum[,"start.pumps"] <- floor(runif(runs,1,13))
  dat.sum[,"sd.pumps"] <- sample(0:3, runs, replace = TRUE)
  dat.sum[,"beta"] <- runif(runs,beta_lims[1],beta_lims[2])
  dat.sum.start <- dat.sum
  
  sims <- lapply(c("diff", "diffoutcome", "null"), function(predictor){

    dat.sum <- dat.sum.start

    raw <- lapply(split(as.data.frame(dat.sum), as.data.frame(dat.sum)$subject), function(j){
      dat <- matrix(ncol = 14, nrow = 60)
      colnames(dat) <- c("trial", "limit", "n_pumps", "outcome", "outcome.01", "diff", "points", "diffoutcome", "start", "walk", "pred", "sd", "beta", "start.pumps")
      dat[,"trial"] <- 1:60
      dat[,"limit"] <- floor(runif(60, min=0, max=13))
      dat[,"sd"] <- j$sd.pumps
      dat[,"start.pumps"] <- j$start.pumps
      dat[,"beta"] <- j$beta
      
       for(i in 1:60){
        start <- ifelse(i==1,NA,dat[i-1,"n_pumps"])
        walk <- rnorm(1,0,j$sd.pumps)
        pred <- ifelse(predictor!="null",dat[i-1,predictor]*j$beta,0)
        dat[i,c("start", "walk", "pred")] <- c(start, walk, pred)
        dat[i,"n_pumps"] <- round(ifelse(i == 1, j$start.pumps, 
                                   start + walk + pred),0)
        dat[i,"n_pumps"] <- ifelse(dat[i,"n_pumps"] < 1, 1, dat[i,"n_pumps"])
        dat[i,"n_pumps"] <- ifelse(dat[i,"n_pumps"] > 12, 12, dat[i,"n_pumps"])
        dat[i,"outcome"] <- ifelse(dat[i,"n_pumps"]>dat[i,"limit"],-1,1)
        dat[i,"outcome.01"] <- ifelse(dat[i,"n_pumps"]>dat[i,"limit"],0,1)
        dat[i,"diff"] <- dat[i,"limit"] - dat[i,"n_pumps"]
        dat[i, "diffoutcome"] <- dat[i, "outcome.01"]*12 - dat[i, "n_pumps"]
      }
  
      dat[,"points"] <- dat[,"n_pumps"]*dat[,"outcome.01"]
      dat
    })
    
    list(summary=as.data.frame(dat.sum), raw=raw)
    
   })
  names(sims) <- c("diff", "diffoutcome", "null")
  
  sims <- lapply(sims, function(predictor){
    x <- rbindlist(lapply(predictor$raw, function(dat){
      dat <- as.data.frame(dat)
      dat$prev.outcome <- factor(c(NA, dat$outcome[1:nrow(dat)-1]), levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("bust","bank"))
      data.frame(mean.points=mean(dat$points), mean.points.bank=ifelse(sum(!is.na(dat$prev.outcome=="bank"))>0, mean(dat$points[dat$prev.outcome=="bank"],na.rm=T),NA), mean.points.bust=ifelse(sum(!is.na(dat$prev.outcome=="bust"))>0, mean(dat$points[dat$prev.outcome=="bust"],na.rm=T),NA))
    }))
    predictor$summary <- cbind(predictor$summary,x)
    predictor
  })
  
  sims
}

# max function is performed over all trials, bank trials only, bust trials only. All trials are reported in the manuscript
max <- lapply(list(all=NULL,bank=".bank",bust=".bust"), function(txt){
  data.frame(max.points=unlist(lapply(list(`Outcome observer`="diffoutcome", `Information seeker`="diff"), function(mod){
    unlist(lapply(0:3, function(sd){
      data <- list(mod=walk[[mod]]$summary[walk[[mod]]$summary$sd.pumps==sd,],null=walk$null$summary[walk$null$summary$sd.pumps==sd,])
      if(!is.null(txt)){
        switch(txt,
               ".bank" = list(mod=data$mod[data$mod$outcome==1,],null=data$null[data$null$outcome==1,]),
               ".bust" = list(mod=data$mod[data$mod$outcome==-1,],null=data$null[data$null$outcome==-1,])
        )}
      max(predict(gam(formula = as.formula(paste0("mean.points",txt," ~ s(beta, bs='cs')")), data=data$mod), newdata = data.frame(beta=seq(0,1,0.001))) - predict(gam(formula = as.formula(paste0("mean.points",txt, " ~ s(beta, bs='cs')")), data=data$null), newdata = data.frame(beta=seq(0,1,0.001))))
    }))
  })), predictor=rep(c("Outcome observer", "Information seeker"), each=4), sd=rep(0:3,2))
})

print(fig_4_b <- ggplot(max$all, aes(x=sd, y=max.points, fill=factor(predictor, levels=c("Outcome observer", "Information seeker"), labels=c("Outcome observer", "Information seeker"))))+geom_bar(position = position_dodge(), stat="identity")+theme_classic()+scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name="")+scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits=c(0, 1.25), breaks = seq(0,1.2,0.2))+labs(x=expression(paste("Response volatility (", sigma, ")")), y="Simulated max point gain", title="b")+theme(legend.position = c(0.7,0.9)))

wrap_plots(fig_4_a, fig_4_b)

gains <- lapply(list(all=NULL,bank=".bank",bust=".bust"), function(txt){
  rbindlist(lapply(list(`Outcome observer`="diffoutcome", `Information seeker`="diff"), function(mod){
    rbindlist(lapply(list("0"=0,"1"=1,"2"=2,"3"=3), function(sd){
      data <- list(mod=walk[[mod]]$summary[walk[[mod]]$summary$sd.pumps==sd,],null=walk$null$summary[walk$null$summary$sd.pumps==sd,])
      if(!is.null(txt)){
        switch(txt,
               ".bank" = list(mod=data$mod[data$mod$outcome==1,],null=data$null[data$null$outcome==1,]),
               ".bust" = list(mod=data$mod[data$mod$outcome==-1,],null=data$null[data$null$outcome==-1,])
        )}
      df <- data.frame(beta=seq(0,1,0.001))
      df$mean.points.pred = predict(gam(formula = as.formula(paste0("mean.points",txt," ~ s(beta, bs='cs')")), data=data$mod), newdata = df)
      df$mean.points.null = predict(gam(formula = as.formula(paste0("mean.points",txt," ~ s(beta, bs='cs')")), data=data$null), newdata = df)
      df$gain <- df$mean.points.pred- df$mean.points.null
      df
    }), idcol = "sd")
  }), idcol = "predictor")
})


# print figures
fig_S3_a <- ggplot(gains$all[gains$all$predictor=="Outcome observer"], aes(x=beta, y=gain, col=factor(sd)))+stat_smooth(se=F)+theme_classic()+scale_color_manual(name = expression(paste("Response volatility (",sigma,")")), values=RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds")[c(9,7,5,3)])+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.5,1))+labs(title="Outcome observer", y="Points gain", x=expression(alpha[o]))
fig_S3_b <- ggplot(gains$all[gains$all$predictor=="Information seeker"], aes(x=beta, y=gain, col=factor(sd)))+stat_smooth(se=F)+theme_classic()+scale_color_manual(name = "", values=RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[c(9,7,5,3)])+coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.5,1))+labs(title="Information seeker", y="Points gain", x=expression(alpha[i]))

print(fig_S3 <- wrap_plots(fig_S3_a, fig_S3_b, guides = "collect"))
```

## Replication study
```{r replication SOM}

url <- paste0('https://osf.io/fmek8//?action=download')
filename <- 'replication.csv'
GET(url, write_disk(filename, overwrite = TRUE))
replication <- read.csv(filename, header=TRUE, na.strings="NA")


# analyses
# Manuscript: difference score
# Information
round(mean(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & replication$information_seeking]),2)
round(sd(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & replication$information_seeking])/sqrt(length(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & replication$information_seeking])),2)

# No information
round(mean(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & !replication$information_seeking]),2)
round(sd(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & !replication$information_seeking])/sqrt(length(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & !replication$information_seeking])),2)

t.test(replication$emo_diff[replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], replication$emo_diff[!replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], paired=F, alternative = "two.sided")
effectsize::cohens_d(replication$emo_diff[replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], replication$emo_diff[!replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], paired=F)

summary(model <- lm(scale(emo_diff)~ifelse(information_seeking, 1, -1)*(scale(missed, scale = F)), data=replication[replication$outcome=="bank",]))
summary(model_no_inf <- lm(scale(emo_diff)~ifelse(information_seeking, 1, 0)*(scale(missed, scale = F)), data=replication[replication$outcome=="bank",]))
summary(model_inf <- lm(scale(emo_diff)~ifelse(information_seeking, 0, 1)*(scale(missed, scale = F)), data=replication[replication$outcome=="bank",]))

confint(model)
confint(model_no_inf)
confint(model_inf)


# SOM: second ratings only
round(mean(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & replication$information_seeking]),2)
round(sd(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & replication$information_seeking])/sqrt(length(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & replication$information_seeking])),2)

# No information
round(mean(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & !replication$information_seeking]),2)
round(sd(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & !replication$information_seeking])/sqrt(length(replication$emo_diff[replication$outcome=="bank" & !replication$information_seeking])),2)

t.test(replication$emo_rating_2[replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], replication$emo_rating_2[!replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], paired=F, alternative = "two.sided")
effectsize::cohens_d(replication$emo_rating_2[replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], replication$emo_rating_2[!replication$information_seeking & replication$outcome=="bank"], paired=F)

# models controlling for the number of pumps

confint(model_diff)

summary(model_r2 <- lm(scale(emo_rating_2)~ifelse(information_seeking, 1, -1)+scale(n_pumps, scale = F), data=replication[replication$outcome=="bank",]))
confint(model_r2)



fig_S4_a <- plot_summary(replication[replication$outcome=="bank",], y="emo_diff", col='factor(information_seeking, levels=c(F,T), labels=c("No information", "Information"))', title="a", geom = "mean_ci", guide=F, guide.name = NA, y.lab = "Emotion change (Rating 2 - Rating 1)", adjust=1.5)+theme(legend.position = c(0.8,0.2))+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-500,300))

fig_S4_b <- ggplot(replication[replication$outcome=="bank",], aes(x=missed, y=emo_diff, col=factor(information_seeking, levels=c(F,T), labels=c("No information", "Information")), fill=factor(information_seeking, levels=c(F,T), labels=c("No information", "Information"))))+stat_smooth(method="lm")+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name="Information seeking")+scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name="Information seeking")+theme_classic()+labs(x="Missed opportunity", y="Emotion change (Rating 2 - Rating 1)", title="b")+scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,12))+theme(legend.position = c(0.8,0.9))+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-500,300))
```

## SOM: Bust Emotional experience
```{r bust emotional experience}
# main effects of information seeking, pump value, and size of the missed opportunity on emotion change rating
emo_bust_1 <- lapply(study_data$bust, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~information_received_ec+pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC+
          (1+information_received_ec+pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})

# add interactions with information seeking - there are singular fit warnings for some of these models. These are resolved by removing the random effect of pump value without dramatically changing the results.
emo_bust_2 <- lapply(study_data$bust, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~information_received_ec*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)+
          (1+information_received_ec*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})

# run the meta analysis and print the data frame
meta_emo_bust_1 <- meta_func(emo_bust_1, studies)
meta_emo_bust_2 <- meta_func(emo_bust_2, studies)
kable(meta_emo_bust_1$df, digits = 3)
kable(meta_emo_bust_2$df, digits = 3)


# simple slopes (information received is dummy coded in both directions and main effects give simple slopes)
emo_bust_inf <- lapply(study_data$bust, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~inf_not_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)+
          (1+inf_not_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})

emo_bust_no_inf <- lapply(study_data$bust, function(trial_data){
  lmer(data = trial_data, formula = emotion_change_rating_Z~inf_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)+
          (1+inf_received_dummy*(pump_value_IDS+diff_pumps_limit_IDC)||subject), 
       control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
})


# run the meta analysis and print the data frame
meta_emo_inf_bust <- meta_func(emo_bust_inf, studies)
meta_emo_no_inf_bust <- meta_func(emo_bust_no_inf, studies)

kable(meta_emo_inf_bust$df, digits = 3)
kable(meta_emo_no_inf_bust$df, digits = 3)


# combine and summarise for plots
bust_data_all <- rbindlist(study_data$bust, fill = T, use.names = T, idcol = "experiment")
bust_data_all$`Information seeking` <- factor(bust_data_all$information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels = c("No information", "Information"))

summary_dat_bust = ddply(bust_data_all, .(subject, experiment, information_received_ec), summarize, emotion_change_rating = mean(emotion_change_rating))
summary_dat_bust$`Information seeking` <- factor(summary_dat_bust$information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels = c("No information", "Information"))

# plots
fig_S1_a <- rain_plot(summary_dat_bust)
fig_S1_b <- ggplot(bust_data_all, aes(x=diff_pumps_limit, y=emotion_change_rating_IDC, col=factor(information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("No information", "Information")), group=interaction(experiment, factor(information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("No information", "Information")))))+stat_smooth(geom="line", alpha=0.5,method="lm", se=F)+theme_classic()+labs(x="Missed opportunity", y="Emotion change rating",title="b")+stat_smooth(mapping=aes(x=diff_pumps_limit, y=emotion_change_rating_IDC, col=factor(information_received_ec, levels=c(-1,1), labels=c("No information", "Information"))), method ="lm", inherit.aes = F)+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-200,200))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-12,12))+scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name="")+theme(legend.position = c(0.85,0.85))
wrap_plots(fig_S1_a, fig_S1_b)
```
